Taiwan’s AI Cyberattack Offers a Warning for Global Banks
results.description: An AI-assisted attack against Taiwan shows how autonomous agents can accelerate conventional hacking techniques, challenging banks and regulators to rethink identity controls, third-party risk, and cyber resilience.
